other_conditions: Applicant must be an Ex‑serviceman or the widow of an Ex‑serviceman
Applicant must be registered with the Department of Sainik Welfare, Puducherry
Applicant must not be a member of the Ex‑Servicemen Contributory Health Scheme (ECHS)
Application must be submitted within three months from the date of purchase or completion of treatment
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of ₹20,000 is provided for the purchase of a denture, credited to the beneficiary’s bank account via RTGS/NEFT.
